channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Onyeka Okongwu | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Onyeka Okongwu from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
“Okongwu's a good player, and I know from my own experience with a fractured face and chipped teeth.... It wasn't intentional, and I know it's going to be a long day at the dentist for him, so hopefully he has a good recovery.”

Jaylen Brown on Onyeka Okongwu, Jan 29, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jalen Johnson on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Johnson said about Young.

“And all the stuff he’s done for the city and just being a Hawk, there was just a lot of emotions at that time. And I think it was only me, and O [Onyeka Okongwu] that have been around since he’s been here. His speech was good, but like he said, ‘It’s a business at the end of the day.’ And as long as he’s happy, we’re happy.’”

Jalen Johnson on Onyeka Okongwu, Jan 15, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Trae Young on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Trae Young on Onyeka Okongwu:

“He's been playing super big-time for us. Going 8-for-9 tonight and not really missing, that's big for us,finishing around the rim and his rebounding, and his contesting and fighting for boards has been big for us.”

Trae Young on Onyeka Okongwu, Jan 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu:

“He was energy for us last year. So we're hoping he can get out on the floor and be that same energy.”

Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu, Dec 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu:

“We'll put him out there. Get him some minutes tonight at that backup 5 position. And hopefully he can bring that energy that he brought to us last year.”

Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu, Dec 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu:

“I don't have a timeline for Big O either. We're giving him as much time as he needs to be with familyand when I hear a date that he will return, I'm assuming he will return to us and start working with us and hopefully be available soon.”

Nate McMillan on Onyeka Okongwu, Dec 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Lloyd Pierce on rookie Onyeka Okongwu:

“The kid is really physical. He's going to be a guy where when he screens, the defender's going to feel him.”

Lloyd Pierce on Onyeka Okongwu, Dec 27, 2020. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Travis Schlenk on Onyeka Okongwu:

“He's an unbelievable person. Since I've been here, we've said character's at the top of our list, and he certainly checks that box in a big way.”

Travis Schlenk on Onyeka Okongwu, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Onyeka Okongwu
item.description:
Schlenk on Okongwu's offense:

“He's got unbelievable hands, he catches everything. He's got the 7ft wingspan and he can run the floor, so we're really excited about him. He's a good FT shooter so we think with time he's going to be able to extend his range.”

Travis Schlenk on Onyeka Okongwu, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.
